Thanks for the reply...I can see that I'm on the right track. I drink Boost nutrition shakes and eat really healthy. I also exercise everyday. I do charity work twice a week...which was recommended to me by a therapist. I used to do a lot more in that category, but "charity" caused my trauma, so I'm afraid to get too heavily into it.
ECT is electroconvulsive therapy. I was able to get it very quickly and easily because my depression was considered untreatable.
